acquisition_method: Data-dependent acquisition (DDA) was performed with the resolution of the Orbitrap set to 30,000, with a fill time of 94 ms and a limitation of 1 × 105 ions.
cleavage_agent: Further parameters were trypsin as a protease with an allowance of a maximum of two missed cleavages, a minimum peptide length of seven amino acids, and at least two unique peptides required for protein identification.
collision_energy: A normalized collision energy of 34 was applied.
fractionation_method: Off-line high pH reverse phase fractionation was carried out on an Agilent 1200 Infinity high-performance liquid chromatography system, equipped with a Gemini C18 column (3 μm, 110 Å, 100 × 1.0 mm, Phenomenex).
ionization_type: An UltiMate 3000 RSLC nano LC system (Dionex) equipped with an μ-Precolumn (C18 PepMap 100, 5μm, 300 μm i.d. × 5 mm, 100 Å) and an analytical column (nanoEase M/Z HSS T3 column 75 µm × 250 mm C18, 1.8 μm, 100 Å, Waters) was coupled directly to an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid Mass Spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) using the Nanospray Flex ion source in positive ion mode.
labeling: For each sample, 20 μg of peptides were labeled with TMT Isobaric Label Reagent (Thermo Fisher Scientific) according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
mass_analyzer: Full mass scan was acquired with mass range 375–1500 m/z in profile mode in the Orbitrap with resolution of 120,000.

instrument.value: Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid Mass Spectrometer
instrument.evidence: An UltiMate 3000 RSLC nano LC system (Dionex) equipped with an μ-Precolumn (C18 PepMap 100, 5μm, 300 μm i.d. × 5 mm, 100 Å) and an analytical column (nanoEase M/Z HSS T3 column 75 µm × 250 mm C18, 1.8 μm, 100 Å, Waters) was coupled directly to an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid Mass Spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) using the Nanospray Flex ion source in positive ion mode.

ptm.value: Carbamidomethyl (C), TMT16 (K), Acetyl (Protein N-term), Oxidation (M), TMT10 or TMT16 (N-term)
ptm.evidence: The following modifications were included into the search parameters: Carbamidomethyl (C) and TMT16 (K) as fixed modifications, Acetyl (Protein N-term), Oxidation (M) and TMT10 or TMT16 (N-term) as variable modifications.
